We are committed to transparency and the privacy of our global audience's data. The site was designed under the premise of
Privacy by Design
. We do not require registration to use the calculators, and the clinical data entered into the tools is processed exclusively in your browser, without being sent to our servers. To enable the site's operation, security, and advertising display, we automatically collect data such as IP address, date and time of access, cookies, and page interaction data, as detailed in our Privacy Policy.

For an in-depth view of how we protect information within the ecosystem and in compliance with European principles and the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13.709/2018 - LGPD), please access our detailed
Official Privacy Policy
.
